definitions.gloss: alcoholic beverages; liquor; alcohol (as a category)
definitions.explanation: A formal or official term for alcoholic drinks as a category. Commonly seen on signs, in laws, and in business contexts rather than in casual conversation.

examples.japanese: {酒類|しゅるい}の{販売|はんばい}は{禁止|きんし}されています。
examples.english: The sale of alcoholic beverages is prohibited.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}では{酒類|しゅるい}の{持|も}ち{込|こ}みはできません。
examples.english: Bringing your own alcohol is not allowed at this establishment.

examples.japanese: {未成年者|みせいねんしゃ}への{酒類|しゅるい}の{提供|ていきょう}は{法律|ほうりつ}で{禁|きん}じられている。
examples.english: Providing alcoholic beverages to minors is prohibited by law.

notes:
An official, formal term for alcoholic beverages as a category. Commonly encountered on store signs, in legal texts, and in business/regulatory contexts. In casual speech, お{酒|さけ} is used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒類|しゅるい}の{販売|はんばい}: sale of alcohol
- {酒類|しゅるい}{提供|ていきょう}: serving of alcohol
- {酒類|しゅるい}{免許|めんきょ}: liquor license
- {酒類|しゅるい}の{持|も}ち{込|こ}み: bringing in one's own alcohol
- {酒類|しゅるい}{取扱店|とりあつかいてん}: establishment licensed to sell alcohol

HOMOPHONE NOTE:
Not to be confused with {種類|しゅるい} (type, kind), which has the same reading but entirely different meaning and kanji.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- お{酒|さけ}: alcohol, sake — everyday term for alcoholic drinks
- アルコール: alcohol — also used in everyday speech and on product labels
- {酒類|しゅるい}: the formal/regulatory category term
